title: Idempotent API Architecture & Deduplication
learningObjectives: Implement the Idempotency-Key header pattern for mutating POST requests
Manage atomic reservation, processing locks, and cached response storage
Handle concurrent identical requests with HTTP 409 Conflict or lock waits
keyTradeoffs: Database transactional locking vs Redis distributed locks for in-flight requests
Storing full response body payloads vs returning idempotent status pointers
commonPitfalls: Caching idempotent responses before verifying that the underlying transaction succeeded
Failing to scope idempotency keys to individual authenticated users/tenants
transferPrompt: How does payment processing rely on idempotency keys to prevent accidental double-charging during network blips?
